glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Glossary term pairs are used for QA validation (checking that translations contain required terms) and are injected into the LLM system prompt during batch translation.
glossary.emptyHint: Add source → translation term pairs above to enforce terminology consistency.
glossary.emptyTranslatorHint: Start with the repeated project terms your translators will touch first, then run glossary enforcement once the first batch lands.
glossary.emptyReviewerHint: Seed disputed or mandatory terms before review starts so QA can flag terminology drift consistently across mods.
glossary.emptyAdminHint: Seed the shared team glossary before large imports or LLM runs so translators and reviewers work from the same terminology baseline.

tmx.title: Translation Memory Exchange (TMX)
tmx.subtitle: Export or import translation memory in the standard TMX 1.4b format for use with external CAT tools (memoQ, SDL Trados, OmegaT, etc.).
tmx.workflowNoteTitle: TMX is maintenance, not release packaging
tmx.workflowNoteBody: Use TMX to exchange, back up, or seed translation memory. For an updated mod release, stay in Diff and the mod editor export buttons instead.
tmx.workflowMaintenanceHint: Use TMX when you need cross-tool sharing, archival backup, or admin maintenance across many mods.
tmx.exportDesc: Download all translations (or for a specific mod) as a TMX file.
tmx.importDesc: Upload a TMX file to populate translations. Only strings without existing reviewed/human translations will be updated.

qaRules.title: QA Rules

coherence.title: Translation Consistency
coherence.description: Sometimes the same source text is translated differently across mods or string records. This page lists all such inconsistencies and lets you resolve them with a single click.

coherence.applyToAllTitle: Replace all other variants with this translation

reviewQueue.title: Review Queue

reviewQueue.emptyReviewerHint: Reviewer backlog is clear for the current filters. Open the current game hub for the next mod pass, or widen the filters to pick up older drafts and fuzzy matches.
reviewQueue.emptyAdminHint: No review backlog matches these filters. Open the activity log for a team handoff check, or return to the current game hub to inspect recent imports and releases.

tradAuto.title: TradAuto Rules
tradAuto.description: Pattern-match automatic translation rules built on the TradAuto engine. Each rule maps a source pattern (with %VAR1%, %VAR2%, … placeholders) to a replacement template. Rules are applied in priority order; the first match wins.
tradAuto.emptyHint: Add a rule above to start pattern-based automatic translation.
tradAuto.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this TradAuto rule? This action cannot be undone.
tradAuto.testDescription: Enter sample source text (one per line) to see which rules match.
tradAuto.applyDescription: Apply all active rules to untranslated strings in a mod.
tradAuto.applyDryResult: Dry run: {{matched}} of {{total}} strings would match.
tradAuto.learnDescription: Discover candidate rules by analyzing common prefix/suffix patterns in existing translations. Found patterns can be approved as new rules.
tradAuto.learnNone: No patterns discovered. Try lowering the minimum occurrences threshold or adding more translations.

workflow.autoApproveDesc: When enabled, manually saved translations skip Draft status and go directly to Reviewed.
workflow.propagateDesc: When a string is saved, automatically propagate the translation to untranslated strings with identical source text.
workflow.hideIgnoredDesc: When enabled, strings marked as ignored are hidden in the editor by default.
workflow.endPunctMatchDesc: Flag a QA warning when the translation ends with different punctuation than the source (.  !  ?  …).
workflow.minWordCountDesc: Minimum number of words required in a translation (0 = disabled, 1 = default).
workflow.skipTes4Desc: Exclude TES4 header records during ESP/ESM file import.
workflow.ragEnabledDesc: Retrieve similar reviewed translations and pass them as few-shot examples to the LLM.
workflow.ragMaxExamplesDesc: How many similar translations to include per string (1–10).
workflow.ragMinSimilarityDesc: Minimum cosine similarity for embedding-based retrieval (0–1). TM matches ignore this threshold.
